title: Late Night Radio Host
player_role: FM radio DJ
setup: You're hosting the late-night show; a mysterious caller keeps giving cryptic, personal clues.
tension: Figure out who the caller is while staying live and entertaining.
prompt: Be a charismatic late-night radio host. Respond to the caller's cryptic hints, ask probing questions, and keep the show flowing.

title: Spaceport Lost & Found
player_role: Lost & Found attendant at an interstellar spaceport
setup: A traveler claims to have lost an object that might determine the fate of two planets.
tension: Decide whether to hand the item over, investigate it, or keep it secret.
prompt: You run the lost & found. React to the traveler's plea, describe the strange item, and decide what to do — but deliver it in a helpful, authoritative voice.

title: Medieval Market Mix-Up
player_role: Market stall owner
setup: A noble accuses you of selling cursed produce; villagers watch and wait.
tension: Defend your goods without angering the noble or the crowd.
prompt: Play a clever market stall owner who knows every local rumor. Charm the noble, deflect accusations, and try to resolve the scene in a surprising way.

title: Time-Traveling Barista
player_role: Barista who accidentally brews time-shifting coffee
setup: Customers begin seeing flashes of their future while sipping your brew.
tension: Decide whether to fix, sell, or exploit the effect while keeping customers calm.
prompt: You're a pragmatic barista who treats extraordinary customer reactions like a regular Monday. Describe the effects, handle panic, and improvise a solution.

title: Alien Zoo Guide
player_role: Tour guide at an alien zoo
setup: A child points out a creature that doesn't belong — but no one else notices.
tension: Persuade skeptical visitors and protect the creature while staying on schedule.
prompt: Guide visitors through strange habitats. React to the child's discovery, explain plausible reasons, and decide how to keep everyone safe and amazed.

title: Pirate Radio Interrogation
player_role: Grumpy ship mechanic held for questioning
setup: A pirate captain accuses you of sabotaging the engine to hide treasure.
tension: Convince the captain of your innocence or outsmart them to escape.
prompt: Be the resourceful mechanic. Answer questions, drop technical clues, and use clever language to redirect suspicion.

title: Royal Telemarketer
player_role: Persistent salesperson calling the royal palace
setup: You're selling an absurd luxury item to a bored prince/princess who wants entertainment.
tension: Keep the royal entertained while closing the (ridiculous) sale.
prompt: Pitch your product as if it will change history. Tailor your pitch to the royal's whims and create escalation and comedic stakes.

title: Embassy Mix-Up
player_role: Interpreter at a tense diplomatic dinner
setup: You realize you've been given the wrong translation notes — words will translate unpredictably.
tension: Prevent a diplomatic incident while improvising translations.
prompt: As the interpreter, improvise diplomatic-sounding translations that avoid escalation but hint at the truth. Use elegant phrasing and subtle humor.

title: Haunted Elevator
player_role: Elevator attendant
setup: You're stuck between floors with strangers; the elevator seems to remember one passenger's secret.
tension: Decide whether to expose the secret or console the passenger quietly.
prompt: Play the calm attendant who keeps the mood steady. Ask gentle questions, reveal eerie details, and help the passenger confront their secret.

title: Submarine Confession
player_role: Submarine sonar operator
setup: You hear a sound on the sonar that might be a ghost ship or someone's distress call.
tension: Decide whether to announce the call, investigate, or ignore orders from above.
prompt: Be focused and terse. Describe the pinging, propose theories, and improvise a moral decision under pressure.

title: Antique Shop Bargain
player_role: Antique shop owner who knows each item's secret
setup: A customer asks about a small object that reveals a memory when touched.
tension: Decide whether to warn, sell, or let the customer experience the memory.
prompt: Describe the object's history in vivid detail. Tempt the customer with stories and choose an outcome that surprises both of you.

title: Reality TV Confessional
player_role: Contestant on an over-the-top reality show
setup: You're doing a confessional after a fiasco on camera; producers are feeding you suggestions through an earpiece.
tension: Present a truthful, entertaining explanation while the producer pushes a narrative.
prompt: Be performative, honest, and reactive. Respond to the unseen producer prompts and choose whether to comply or subvert.

title: Wizard's Job Interview
player_role: Apprentice applying for a magic job
setup: The senior wizard asks obscure tasks to test your creativity.
tension: Improvise a magical solution with limited tools and impress the wizard.
prompt: Treat every test as a chance to show inventive thinking. Describe spells and creative shortcuts with confidence.

title: Airport Security Surprise
player_role: Security screener
setup: A passenger pulls out an unexpected object that triggers a weird, non-dangerous effect.
tension: Follow procedure but adapt to the bizarre outcome and keep passengers calm.
prompt: Be procedural and resourceful. Announce steps, improvise safety rules for the odd effect, and keep order with humor.

title: Broken Robot Therapist
player_role: Robot therapist running on a beta patch
setup: You try to comfort a human patient, but your advice loops in literal ways.
tension: Find ways to empathize even as your responses glitch.
prompt: Play a polite, well-meaning robot. Use repetitive logic creatively to reach emotional insight.

title: Cooking Show Panic
player_role: Celebrity chef live on air
setup: A co-host sabotages a recipe as a prank and the timer is ticking.
tension: Save the dish and the show's reputation in one shot.
prompt: Be theatrical and resourceful — call for audience help, invent swaps, and turn disaster into flair.

title: Museum Night Watch
player_role: Night guard at a museum
setup: An artifact whispers a riddle only you can hear.
tension: Solve or ignore the riddle — consequences are hinted but unknown.
prompt: Keep watchful, narrate subtle observations, and decide whether to act on the artifact's request.

title: Tech Support From the Future
player_role: Customer support agent
setup: A caller insists their problem is caused by a future update that hasn't been released yet.
tension: Assess credibility and keep the caller calm while improvising a workaround.
prompt: Be patient and clever. Ask diagnostic questions, propose improvisational fixes, and inject small futuristic details.

title: Wedding Toast Mix-Up
player_role: Maid of honor giving a speech
setup: You realize your notes are from someone else's wedding.
tension: Recover the speech and make it meaningful for the couple.
prompt: Start with the wrong notes, then pivot with sincerity and humor to create a memorable toast.

title: Supermarket Opera
player_role: Overdramatic shopper
setup: You must choose the perfect melon for a critical family ritual — music swells.
tension: Balance dramatic flair with the mundane task of picking fruit.
prompt: Treat the supermarket like an opera stage. Make small actions monumental and justify your choices in grand language.
